note: DT.1j (T1 GraphQL schema vs selection, extraction half): the SDL object type `type Item` is a MESSAGE_TYPE `message:graphql:Item` with its declared fields as SCHEMA_FIELDS (format graphql), a root field carries its return type as a graphql_returns MESSAGE_TYPE cell, and an operation carries its selection set as a graphql_selection MESSAGE_TYPE cell. The console selects `barcode`, which `type Item` lacks. HEAD 2b80361b (verifier, on a copy): no MESSAGE_TYPE node, `[graphql-sdl] files=1 resolvers=4`; graded node 0/1, cells 0/3, forbid 0. DT.1n (the compare half) judges each GRAPHQL_CALLS op's selection against the type its root field returns, so it needs both pairings: AdjustStock -> adjustStock and ListItems -> items, the second by the root field its document selects (DT.11a; the op name ListItems keys no resolver). Graded at d8051a4b (DT.11a landed in w15): GRAPHQL_CALLS 2/2. The verdicts are contract_fields rows, which no key field expresses: engine/tests/model_graphql.rs pins `mutation AdjustStock adjustStock` identical and `query ListItems items` breaking (barcode graphql_field_undefined). DT.1k (graphql_model identity): each client call types its result (`client.query<{ items: InventoryItem[] }>({ query: LIST_ITEMS })`, `client.mutate<{ adjustStock: InventoryItem }>({ mutation: ADJUST_STOCK })`), a graphql_result MESSAGE_TYPE cell on the calling FUNCTION naming its document; the models pass resolves the document to its STATE_VAR, the op minted in that const's span, the root field each result key selects and the type that field returns, and joins InventoryItem (diverged: barcode) and gqlgen's generated model.Item to message:graphql:Item in one SAME_AS class. The hand-written internal stock.Item has the same name and json names but is never generated, so it joins nothing; members join the center only.
